messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\n\nJunior staff can see the integrations tab even though they do not need access, and this visibility is causing confusion among users who should not have it [i:636f7e5217dbdd0d].\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- Saltmarsh Specialty, an account with 740000.0 GBP in ARR and a renewal date of 2027-05-15, raised this concern [i:636f7e5217dbdd0d].\n- The request came through the sales route, which accounts for 1 mention across 1 route [i:636f7e5217dbdd0d].\n\n## Evidence\n\n- Across 1 accounts and 1 mentions, the only mention of this issue came from the sales route [i:636f7e5217dbdd0d].\n- A user at Saltmarsh Specialty asked whether roles could be adjusted so that only senior handlers see the integrations tab, describing it as causing confusion [i:636f7e5217dbdd0d].\n- There are 0 renewals in the next 90 days tied to this feedback [i:636f7e5217dbdd0d].\n\n## Why now\n\n- The feedback was logged on 2026-09-26, and the fact sheet is current as of 2026-11-03 [i:636f7e5217dbdd0d].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty renews on 2027-05-15, so there is no renewal pressure inside the next 90 days [i:636f7e5217dbdd0d].\n- No insight in the current set points the other way; the single mention is the only signal recorded [i:636f7e5217dbdd0d].\n",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "636f7e5217dbdd0d",
   "quote": "can we adjust roles so only senior handlers see the integrations tab? It’s causing confusion.",
   "account": "Saltmarsh Specialty",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-09-26T14:35:00Z"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "accounts_n": 1,
  "mentions_n": 1,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "sales": 1
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 740000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 0,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Saltmarsh Specialty",
    "arr_gbp": 740000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-05-15",
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the brief's claims against the cited insight and fact sheet. The ARR (740,000 GBP), renewal date (2027-05-15), account (Saltmarsh Specialty), route (sales, 1 mention across 1 route), zero renewals in 90 days, and feedback date (2026-09-26) all match the fact sheet and cited insight. The quoted user language ('causing confusion', 'only senior handlers see the integrations tab') matches the insight quote, and the brief correctly notes no contrary evidence exists. Nothing is overstated or uncited.", "verdict": "pass"}
